changelog: Call Type Detection now has separate Fraud and Flash Calls submenus, keeping each operational analysis easy to find.
The general Fraud panel is available under Call Type Detection → Fraud with engine status, KPIs, recent events, profiles and high-risk countries.
changelog_es: Call Type Detection incorpora los submenús Fraude y Flash Calls para separar claramente ambos análisis operativos.
El panel general de fraude vuelve a estar visible bajo Call Type Detection → Fraude, con estado del motor, KPIs, eventos recientes, perfiles y países de ries
